senses.gloss:
Dyotana is, according to Sāyaṇa, the name of a prince in
the Rigveda.^1 This is probably correct, though the word may
also^2 be interpreted as denoting ‘glorification’ but it is not
clear what relation existed between Dyotana and the other
persons mentioned in the same passage, Vetasu, Daśoṇi,
Tūtuji, and Tugra.
1) vi. 20, 8.
2) As by Griffith, Hymns of the Rigveda,
1, 380.
Cf. Oldenberg, Zeitschrift der Deutschen
Morgenländischen Gesellschaft, 55, 328.
